goalSummary: Complete quiz by selecting correct answers
cycleDescription: One iteration of the main workflow

cycleStartSteps.description: Select an incomplete quiz to take or retake
cycleStartSteps.instruction: Select a quiz that needs to be completed. Priority: 1) Click 'Take test' for untouched quizzes, 2) Click 'Retake test' for quizzes showing 'Started' status (failed attempts), 3) Skip quizzes showing 'Completed' status.
cycleStartSteps.targetElementSelector: {desc:"test button for an incomplete quiz - either Take test or Retake test with Started status"}

waitForReady.waitScript: new Promise((resolve, reject) => { let attempts = 0; const check = () => { attempts++; const allButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a')); const testBtn = allButtons.find(el => { const text = (el.textContent || '').toLowerCase(); const ariaLabel = (el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').toLowerCase(); const combined = text + ' ' + ariaLabel; return (combined.includes('take') || combined.includes('retake')) && (combined.includes('test') || combined.includes('quiz') || combined.includes('assessment')); }); if (testBtn) { console.log(`[waitForReady] Found test button after ${attempts} attempts:`, testBtn.textContent?.trim()); resolve(); } else if (attempts > 300) { console.warn(`[waitForReady] Timeout after ${attempts} attempts`); reject(new Error('No test button found after 300 attempts')); } else { setTimeout(check, 100); } }; check(); })
waitForReady.description: Wait for test buttons (Take test or Retake test) to load

step.instruction: Click the 'Start New Test' button to begin the quiz. Use the click action directly.

waitForReady.waitScript: new Promise(resolve => { const check = () => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(el => el.textContent?.toLowerCase().includes('start new test') || el.textContent?.toLowerCase().includes('start test')); if (btn && window.getComputedStyle(btn).display !== 'none') resolve(); else setTimeout(check, 100); }; check(); })
waitForReady.description: Wait for Start Test button to be visible

steps.description: click all the checkboxes representing the correct answer
steps.instruction: click all the checkboxes representing the correct answer
steps.targetElementSelector: {desc:"checkbox presents the option for correct answer"}

waitForReady.waitScript: new Promise(resolve => { const check = () => { const question = document.querySelector('[class*="question"], [class*="Question"], h1, h2'); const options = document.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"], input[type="checkbox"], [role="radio"], [role="checkbox"]'); if (question && options.length > 0) resolve(); else setTimeout(check, 100); }; check(); })
waitForReady.description: Wait for question and answer options to load

steps.instruction: Click the 'Submit answer' button to submit your answer. Use the click action directly.

waitForReady.waitScript: new Promise(resolve => { const check = () => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(el => el.textContent?.toLowerCase().includes('submit')); if (btn && window.getComputedStyle(btn).display !== 'none' && !btn.disabled) resolve(); else setTimeout(check, 100); }; check(); })
waitForReady.description: Wait for Submit button to be visible and enabled

steps.instruction: Click the 'Next question' button to proceed to the next question. Use the click action directly.

waitForReady.waitScript: new Promise(resolve => { const check = () => { const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(el => el.textContent?.toLowerCase().includes('next')); if (btn && window.getComputedStyle(btn).display !== 'none' && !btn.disabled) resolve(); else setTimeout(check, 100); }; check(); })
waitForReady.description: Wait for Next question button to be visible and enabled

cycleEndSteps.instruction: Click the 'Back to track' button to return to quiz selection. Use the click action directly.
